title: Cost the forest, and say what you assumed
ground: 90,000 square miles of forest, in hydrogen. Biomass at an assumed 200 t/ha is 4,662 Mt at ~6% hydrogen; held water at an assumed 100 kg/m² is 23,310 Mt at 11.2%. Total 2,888 Mt.
task: Redo the calculation with your own two assumptions, show every division, and then write 150 words explaining which assumption the answer is most sensitive to and how you know.

rubric.test: Is every figure shown as a division a reader can repeat?
Are the two assumed inputs marked as assumed, in the working and not only in the prose?

rubric.band: The sensitivity is argued, not asserted
rubric.test: Did you vary each input and report the swing, or did you reason about it in your head and state a conclusion?
Does the shipping answer — six orders of magnitude short — hold under both of your assumptions? If it does not, say so.
